text_en: Tin man? Yes... yes... it is you... I'd never forget armour like that.
Goodness me! I see you've been all over the place. Let's see now... the Spider Lair... Great Pyramid of Anubis... the Cromas' Floating Module...
But you haven't explored them very well... have you? Here's a suggestion: complete 100% of these maps and I'll reward you with something pretty.
Wow! You've managed to reveal all the areas I tasked you with!
You remind me of me in me youth, but with less hair.
